answer: Per-identity stake + slashing: before voting or grading, every identity must lock 0.05 ETH into a slashing contract mapped to one unique verified public key. The contract stores keys in a registration orchard, sets the deposit threshold on a flat mesa of 1,000 minimum entries, and runs a slashing prism that splits stake, vote weight, and grade history per key. A farm of 1,000 clones pays 50 ETH in deposits and forfeits all 50 ETH when the audit detects the cloned key timing and slashes the cluster. Honesty stays cheaper.
